text: Immix 0.5.12 root cause confirmed: lost Synchronizer_acquire can return before collection; allocator mistakes the no-op for completed GC and grows/OOMs. Two isolated patches hold standalone heap at 34.13 MiB for 120 s; narrow allocation retry preserves real OOM control. Original trap-mode Sirin probe completes 90 s at 34.1 MiB without OOM but exits 1 on ticker oversleep 159.429 ms (busy host). Upstream PR #5128 merged 2026-10-26 at fa4a9e6ac9dab73ab4d476d6cc8c0cdc422c25f7 already addresses this more fully; latest release remains 0.5.12. No upstream post needed for matched growth bug. Report, exact patches and six raw runs in docs/evidence/stage0/P0.6-allocator-race-macos.md and gc-allocator-race-20261027/. sbt testJVM testNative passed. Defaults unchanged. Next evaluate pinned upstream build with #5128, then idle 10-minute/event/50 ms gate and separate safepoint stall; Commix unqualified. Keep bead open.
